login.title: Log in
login.signedOutElsewhere: This device was signed out from another of your devices. Sign in again to keep using it.

register.title: Register
register.inviteCodeHint: 16 characters from your administrator, not case-sensitive
register.passwordHint: At least 8 characters, with both letters and digits
register.notice: I understand that the administrator can view chat content.

registered.title: You're registered
registered.explain: You'll need this ID to log in, so make a note of it. You can change it later in Settings.

changePassword.title: Change password
changePassword.forced: For your security, please set a new password first.

forgot.title: Recover the administrator password
forgot.explain: Enter the administrator's email address and we'll send a link. Ordinary users who forgot their password should ask the administrator to reset it.
forgot.sent: If that is the administrator's address, the email is on its way. Open the link in it within 30 minutes.

reset.title: Set a new password
reset.done: The password has been reset and every earlier login has ended. Log in with the new password.
reset.missing: This link is incomplete. Open it again from the email, or request a new one.

confirmEmail.title: Confirm the new email address
confirmEmail.explain: Once confirmed, password recovery emails go to this new address.
